speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're a child with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding gums, and tiny red spots on your skin. Have you noticed any easy bruising or bleeding after minor cuts?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

Given the classic presentation of mucosal bleeding and petechiae in a 4-year-old with no mentioned trauma, I suspect low platelet count. Please have your child come in immediately so I can order a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with platelet count and review any recent viral illnesses. REQUEST TEST: CBC.
